title: Critical: Fix Broken Test Collection
body:
The `pytest` execution fails immediately during collection due to `ModuleNotFoundError` (missing `numpy`, `pandas`) and incorrect relative imports in `src/`. This effectively results in 0% test coverage availability. 

**Action Items:**
1. Ensure CI environment installs all dependencies.
2. Fix import paths in test files to align with `src/` structure.

title: Refactor Legacy Data Processor Monolith
body:
`src/data_processing/data_processor/python/data_processor/Data_Processor_r0.py` is a massive legacy script that defies modern standards. It uses `print` for logging and has poor error handling.

**Action Items:**
1. Break into smaller modules (e.g., `loader`, `processor`, `reporter`).
2. Replace `print` with `logging`.
3. Add unit tests for new modules.

title: Unify Tools Directory Structure
body:
The repository has a split personality regarding tools: `tools/` (root) vs `src/tools/`. This causes confusion.

**Action Items:**
1. Audit root `tools/`.
2. Move active scripts to `src/tools/`.
3. Delete or archive the rest.

title: Enforce Global Linting
body:
`ruff.toml` currently excludes `data_processing`, `scientific_modeling`, and other key areas. This allows technical debt to accumulate.

**Action Items:**
1. Remove one exclusion at a time.
2. Fix the resulting linting errors.
3. Commit changes.
